Documentation release — no code changes.

- README now lists FPGA IP core support (added in 0.3.0): AMD/Xilinx Vivado
  `.hwh`/`.xci`, Microchip Libero Tcl/`.cxf`, Intel/Altera Quartus `*_hw.tcl`.
- README states the supplier privacy rule explicitly: the supplier of an FPGA
  IP core is known locally but deliberately **not** transmitted — names,
  versions and ecosystems only.
- README mentions uv lockfile support (added in 0.2.0).

Verify what leaves your machine: `jochwacht-sbom . --dry-run`
